about.overview: Enhance Beauty Therapy Ltd has been operating for over 20 years from the tranquil location of Prebbleton.

before.title: Enhance Beauty Therapy - 591 Springs Road - Prebbleton - Christchurch

issues.title: Not mobile-friendly
issues.evidence: The page has no responsive viewport tag, so phones show a shrunken desktop layout.

issues.title: Not served over HTTPS
issues.evidence: Final URL is http://www.enhancebeautytherapy.co.nz/. Browsers label this site "Not secure".

issues.title: Built with legacy page techniques
issues.evidence: 0 deprecated tags and 7 layout tables found (modern sites use responsive CSS).

issues.title: No easy way to get in touch
issues.evidence: No tap-to-call link and no enquiry form on the homepage.

issues.title: No search description
issues.evidence: No meta description, so Google chooses random page text for search results.

issues.title: Images missing descriptions
issues.evidence: 9 of 9 images have no alt text (accessibility and SEO).

issues.title: No local-business search markup
issues.evidence: No structured data, so Google has less to show for the business.
